digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions and CI workflow scheduling (reconciler bridge and canary)
propositions: Reconciler bridge cron schedule runs every 20 minutes (*/20) and must be doubled to a uniform 40-minute cadence using three cron entries over a 2-hour cycle

The opt-in continuous reconciliation chain re-dispatches immediately after each pass, creating a 1-pass-duration inter-invocation period that must be doubled by sleeping for the elapsed pass duration before re-dispatch (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s, guarded when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH unset)
Canary workflow runs hourly and must be doubled to run every 2 hours; its staleness alert window must increase from 2 hours to 4 hours to maintain 3x cadence margin
Worst-case reconcile latency increases from 20 to 40 minutes and canary detection latency doubles; this must be documented in jira-sync-setup.md alongside the cadence table
All cron literals, comments, and documentation referencing */20 minute cadence or hourly canary must be updated for truthfulness and consistency across workflows, Jenkinsfile, scripts, and docs
